verses.english: “When a foolish, incompetent untrue person has three qualities they keep themselves broken and damaged. …

verses.pali: sāvajjena kāyakammena, sāvajjena vacīkammena, sāvajjena manokammena …pe….
verses.english: Blameworthy deeds by way of body, speech, and mind. …
When an astute, competent true person has three qualities they keep themselves intact and unscathed. …

verses.pali: anavajjena kāyakammena, anavajjena vacīkammena, anavajjena manokammena …pe….
verses.english: Blameless deeds by way of body, speech, and mind. …”
